train_selection: first 32 rows in frozen training order, disjoint blocks of four
fresh_rollouts: generated from current adapter at every iteration
zero_signal_rule: skip optimizer step entirely when all RL signals are zero
normalization: per-response token mean, then equal mean of all 16 responses
truncation_rule: retain all generated completion tokens; include EOS when present; flag truncation; frozen reward v3

evaluation.baseline: same frozen initial adapter, evaluated once

timing: synchronized generation, old-student scoring, teacher scoring and backward/update; audits/checkpoints/setup/eval separate
planned_resume_check: RL deliberately pauses at the first completed boundary, then resumes the same 8-iteration run
training_backend: verl FSDP engine, one rank, custom synchronous controller
rollout_backend: Hugging Face generation of current live student, FSDP full-parameter context
teacher_backend: frozen Hugging Face Qwen3-4B; sequential same-GPU exact sampled-token scoring
precision: BF16 base and teacher, FP32 LoRA master weights, verl BF16 forward autocast
comparison_to_previous: Same mathematical objective and data, different library stack and numerical execution; no bitwise reproduction claim
generation_api: Transformers 5.12 has removed use_model_defaults; explicit sampling fields are checked in resolved GenerationConfig
dependency_override_reason: Resolve the upstream lock conflicts with mistral-common numpy<2.4 and torch cusparselt==0.8.1
